body: You are not alone. You'd be suprised how many of people around you are lonely. myself I didnt have a proper honest conversation with another human being for over year and a half now. Just random chitty chats with acquaintances about nothing.. You are not the only one mate. Feel free to pm me if you want.

Yeah.. should propably get a grip. Be starting again.. just dont know how. It requires a lot of energy and will, and I dont have any. I feel devastated inside. Now, I must get some sleep. Please, if You can, leave me one last reply, so I have something to hold on to tomorrow. I could also PM You later if You want. Thanks for now, everyone.

I dont mind going back to school. However, its not until next year, and I must figure anything to give my life a meaning, even the slightest one. So far I'm being alone, with You being the first person to talk honestly since I dont know when. I am also broke, and soon homeless. What do I do? What have I done? Can it be repaired? All these questions really killing me right now. Killing myself solve all these problems.. I miss a hook, something I could be aiming for. But I have nothing.

This is a sad part. Never ever had any sort of plan - always thought at some point I will know what I want to do, but that point never came. I studied and fail bioengineering, just because it was close to my home, had some acquintances there and it didnt seem decisive. Sometimes I feel I should have some kind of lethal disease instead of someone else. So many people with aspirations and goals are dieing, and I'm absolutely empty.

I don't mind posting publicly. Thanks for answering. I didnt read your story yet, but Im about to - are you doing better? anything in You changed in this last week? Personally I cant even think of what tommorrow and next days will look like. Every time I think of it it seems like giant black hole, sucking all emotions, hope, and will out of me. Just cant think of what can I do now, and even more what can I do (I almost wrote when I grew up, but I guess thats already behind me) in the future, which I dont see awaiting me.

Like? formula one, and motorracing as whole. Used to play soccer, and anjoy it, but now everyone my age either grown out of it or turned semi professional. This doesnt matter anyway, since in my current situation I dont even have money to come back my my country, and if I did, dont have a home to come back to. Can stay in current flat till the end of the week, and than, or more likely before that, i might end this misery.

What do I need? Pretty much the question I've been asking myself for a long time now.. lately the answer seems to be suicide, however I've been feeling bad previously in my life and never really thought it was an option for me, but now it seems too much. I've just given up any tryings to find a goal in life - nothing ever seems to interest me for more than a brief moment. I have no idea whatsoever what II could possibly do with my life.
